name: tensioner-pawl
title: Tensioner: the pawl
description: A leaf pawl whose square tip meets the ratchet's teeth: it bends over each tooth as the spool winds in and holds it from unwinding.

length.rule: From its post outside the spool gear's reach to the ratchet: lifts a tooth's height (1.5 mm) at 0.45% strain

thick.rule: Eight lines: it holds the spool end-on, as a column; 41 mm long it buckles at 75 N free-ended, against 50 N at the rim for a 100 N strap
